get_image_files_basic: get all png, jpg, and jpeg image files from a directory sorted alphabetically
get_image_files_exclude: get image files from a directory excluding filenames listed in an exclude file
get_image_files_partition: get a partitioned subset of image files for distributed feature extraction across workers
get_image_files_skip_done: get image files skipping those already processed by checking existing npy files in output folder
chunks_iterator: iterate over an array in fixed-size chunks yielding each chunk with its starting index
